Large capacity: compare cooking area before total quarts

Two drawers and one large cavity solve different meals

Draw a typical dinner as a space plan: the protein, vegetables and any side that need different temperatures. Separate drawers can help with two cooking programs, but check the actual synchronization controls. A single large basket can suit a wide piece of food that would not fit either smaller drawer. Total quarts do not establish the usable flat cooking area.

Measure the machine with doors and drawers open

Check the required ventilation clearances, worktop depth and washing-up space. An oven-style air fryer needs room for its door, racks and drip tray; a basket model needs space to pull the drawer out safely. Compare the actual parts that need cleaning after your normal meal.
